notes:
Refers to a Japanese single-edged sword with a curved blade. An iconic symbol of the ⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧ and Japanese culture. Often called "katana" in English.

TYPES OF JAPANESE SWORDS:
- ⟦{日本刀|にほんとう}→日本刀：noentry⟧: Japanese sword (general term)
- ⟦{太刀|たち}→太刀：noentry⟧: long sword (older style, worn edge-down)
- ⟦{打刀|うちがたな}→打刀：noentry⟧: standard katana (worn edge-up)
- ⟦{脇差|わきざし}→脇差：noentry⟧: short sword (worn alongside the katana)
- ⟦{短刀|たんとう}→短刀：noentry⟧: dagger
